Workflow.Name: DealOS | Desk timers
Workflow.Description: Every 15 minutes: gc_CloseLots (seller lots past their bid deadline: highest buyer prices win while quantity lasts, Confirm deal tasks, confirmation and 'not this time' drafts) and gc_DeskFollowUps (chasers after desk.chase_after_hours, lot reminders). Failures are recorded.
